scientific integrity: The proof combines a published universal upper bound with an independently published value of the classical James constant and an explicit sharp pair. The lower-bound calculation is exact over Q(sqrt(2)); the bundled checker only replays algebra and does not substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific limitations: The theorem is restricted to the real regular-octagonal plane and to the Liu--Sarfraz--Li weighted James functional for parameters in (0,1). Search coverage cannot exclude every unindexed or differently phrased source.
title: Exact weighted James profile of the regular octagonal plane
